REPUBLICATION 
July 2026 
LEXINGTON-FAYETTE URBAN COUNTY, KENTUCKY 
CODE of ORDINANCES 
 
Looseleaf Supplement 
 
 This copy of the Lexington-Fayette Urban County Code of Ordinances is issued as a 
"replacement" copy and contains all ordinances deemed advisable to be included at this 
time through Ordinance No. 048-2025, adopted June 26, 2025. See the Code 
Comparative Table for further information. 
 
 This copy replaces all existing copies of the Code as published. Future supplements 
will commence with "Supplement No. 1."

Lexington-Fayette Urban County, Kentucky 
Code of Ordinances 
__________ 
Republished in 2026 by Order of the Urban County Council 
__________
